title: Two Nashville Homes - 8 Beds & Huge Space!
description:
Stay in two incredible homes with 8 beds, 6 full baths, 2 half baths, two stunning balconies, and two incredible living spaces! These townhomes are next door to each other, and in the perfect location to experience the best of Nashville!

You’ll enjoy designer finishes, great kitchens, and all the luxuries of these comfy homes! Plus, you’ll be 10 minutes away from the best of Music City – Broadway, the Gulch, and the best bars & restaurants!

I can’t wait to host you!

The space
You are renting two luxury townhomes located next door to eachother - the perfect getaway for your group! 

There are two large living rooms with Smart TVs, a beautiful kitchen with everything that you'll need for cooking, lightening fast W-Fi, 50" smart televisions, complimentary coffee, a wonderful dining area, and a large balcony with a dining table and gas fireplace.

This is truly one of the best spots in Nashville!

Each bedroom has a luxurious bed with 600 thread count sheets and luxurious pillows. There's a King bed in the master bedroom, along with a Television, a walk-in closet, and a large washroom.

There is tons of space at this property, so you'll never feel crowded at this property. There's also a garage that fits one car, and outdoor parking for an additional two vehicles.

Guest access
You'll have exclusive use of the entire home during your stay. None of the amenities will be shared with other groups.

Other things to note
Nashville has highways and trains throughout the city. You can see/hear the highway from my home, and from time to time you'll hear a train pass by nearby.

This home has a large number of stairs. It is not a good fit for people who have trouble with stairs.

Short Term Rental Permit: #2024 - 08 - 01 - 586 & #2024 - 08 - 01 - 587
